question: Which schema and renderer contracts should HTML ingress and static output share, and which interactive dependencies can be removed?

requirements: Static render callbacks and feature reads use the same document, root and current authored policy as their supplied reader.
Preserve independent public view constructors and privately reuse static readers only while their semantic binding remains valid.
Owned-root source inheritance applies to supported retained rendering contexts, not only ordinary mounts.
Keep original final-tree browser/cadence acceptance distinct from headless output and timing evidence.

evidenceReuse: Reconciled the matching 2026-09-30-content-root-locations-execution outcome and its partial-proof limits, the design and agreement review. Inspected the critical runtime, static, decoration and owned-root changes. Ran two new source-built probes: the cached root helper and actual EditorStatic server output after a proposed-to-accepted switch. Both produce stale proposed text while a fresh accepted reader/render is correct. Ran a new Yjs Plate decoration-boundary probe with public syncSelection and existing FakeAwareness copying generated opaque state; primary/named remote ranges paint only in their own root. Its in-memory root-filter mutation fails the primary-to-caption assertion. Receipt source hashes match; no broad package, browser or benchmark rerun.
summary: Pursue bounded closure repairs, retaining the architecture and most adoption. One reproduced correctness gap remains: getStaticRootView caches by source reader and root but captures authored policy only on first construction. After its owner switches from propose/proposed to edit/accepted, the cached reader and EditorStatic caption still return/render 'Foot draft'; a fresh accepted reader/render returns 'Foot'. The private cache must invalidate or reconcile policy changes without globally interning public views. The admitted retained-fragment DecorationSourcesContext omission remains a supported-combination acceptance gap and needs a focused check rather than an edge-case dismissal. The original Chromium static/AI cadence matrix is unexecuted; matching headless HTML/noise does not pass that browser gate, so the implementation plan's 'none required' closure overstates proof. The Yjs private-wire-format blocker is disproved: public syncSelection plus opaque awareness transport exercises primary/named aliasing and an in-memory mutation makes the assertion fail. Keep this as focused regression coverage; no redesign, view manager or location carrier is needed.

alternatives: Treat matching headless HTML/timing and broad package counts as complete browser/cadence proof: Stop. The original gate measures Chromium render/style/layout and publication cadence; it was not rerun.
Keep static root readers forever by source identity/root alone: Stop. Executed helper and React server-render probes show a valid accepted-mode owner emitting stale proposed caption content.

Invalidate or reconcile private static readers when their source binding/policy changes, with unchanged inputs retaining reuse: Pursue at staticDocumentView.ts; preserve the existing public constructor semantics.
Reopen the full location architecture or add root-qualified carriers/providers/managers: Stop. Existing scoped views and the accepted policy-binding law solve the reproduced defect.

Treat retained-fragment source omission as irrelevant because shipped Plate kits do not declare content roots: Stop as a full-closure claim. Public custom roots and retained markup remain supported combinations; keep a focused acceptance row.

Defer Yjs testing because its awareness wire format is private: Stop. The executed public-syncSelection/opaque-transport probe and failing root-filter mutation provide a narrow test without constructing or exposing that format.
proofLimits: Two source-built static scenarios with one custom Figure and one pending text insertion; one uses the private helper, the other real React server rendering. No client rerender/browser or arbitrary policy combination was measured. Yjs proof uses the real Plate source with one existing fake awareness transport; no network, geometry or browser claim. The mutant disables only the current root filter in Bun memory, not a complete pre-change checkout. Retained-fragment source omission is source-confirmed and admitted in the implementation report; no fresh retained interaction was driven. Broad suite/failure-baseline counts are the prior execution owner's evidence and were not independently rerun; an untouched test file alone cannot establish an unrelated failure. Chromium dual-build streaming benchmark remains unexecuted. Docs/probes are excluded by Ultracite; scoped lint:fix returned no targets (exit 2), N/A rather than green. Review artifact source/reference/whitespace and ledger checks apply only to this assessment.
